text: APPROVE: the new structure scores about 12 (the `while`, two `if (x is null)` checks, two `foreach` loops and the nested `if`, versus about 17 before). `TryList` keeps the same eager materialization and the same swallow-and-skip handling for `IOException` and `UnauthorizedAccessException`, `ShouldScan` keeps the same condition, and the control flow and ordering are unchanged. I didn't build it, and I see no new compiler warnings. I can't rule out an analyzer such as Sonar's S1168 (return empty collections rather than null) objecting to `TryList` returning null, but nothing in the diff shows that rule is enabled.
